title: Early-Payment Credit — Riverbend Self-Pay Outpatient Surgery Package Pre-Service Balance
content:
A pre-service balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking paid well ahead of surgery earns an early-payment credit under Good Faith & Price Estimates.

**Credit.** The days to surgery run from today's date to the scheduled service date, today not counted and the service date counted. Twenty-one or more days to surgery take off two percent (2 percent) of the surgical package price; fourteen to twenty days take off one percent (1 percent); fewer than fourteen days, a passed service date included, take off nothing. The credit is figured on the surgical package price — the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the principal service code on the current version.

| Days to surgery | Credit taken off |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | 2 percent of the surgical package price |
| 14 to 20 | 1 percent of the surgical package price |
| 0 to 13, or a passed service date | nothing |

## Boundaries (hypothetical; surgical package price 4000.00)

- 21 days to surgery: 80.00 taken off. 20 days: 40.00. 14 days: 40.00. 13 days: nothing.
